properties.name: Tooting Bec Lido

properties.name: Parliament Hill Lido
properties.evidence: The lido was opened on 20 August 1938
properties.notes: Most expensive of the London County Council's 13 lidos built in 1920 to 1939.

properties.name: Brockwell Lido

properties.name: Victoria Park Lido
